name: hud_ui_container_destructor_core
description: HudUiContainer::DestructorCore demotes a container object back to the base HudUiContainer vtable.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent HUD container/background class pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4bc7b0 validates a single store of g_HudUiContainer_FTable to self->vptr followed by return.
The native smoke initializes a container with a null vptr, calls DestructorCore, and validates vptr restoration to g_HudUiContainer_FTable.
